description: This file defines a base class for media pipeline IPC testing, including setup, teardown, creation, and management of mock objects and event subscriptions for testing media pipeline IPC components.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing media pipeline IPC components with mocks and event subscriptions.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and prepares the test environment.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects and resets the environment after tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media pipeline IPC object, setting up expectations and mock responses.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to various IPC events and assigns callback handlers.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline IPC object and cleans up event subscriptions.

methods.name: setCreateSessionResponse
methods.description: Sets the session ID in the create session response message.
